summary: WS-A overlay fix (commit 631918cb9) faithfully implements the locked design: a single shared read-only ~/.claude base at auth/_shared/claude-base/.claude (built once, build-to-temp + atomic os.replace, GC-safe location outside any auth/<id>), per-workspace writable upper/work chowned to 1000, and a merged overlay bind-mounted rw at /home/agent/.claude. The merged mount is excluded from the generic rw-chown walk while upper/work are chowned explicitly; overlay-unavailable falls back to the legacy full copy catching specific OSError/SubprocessError, logging CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_UNAVAILABLE and cleaning half-built scratch; teardown_workspace_auth_overlay unmounts-before-remove idempotently and surfaces real umount errors, wired into cli/common.py compose teardown with gc.py untouched; provider_readiness reports per_workspace_overlay/per_workspace_copy via claude_auth_isolation_label; local-service.yml adds cap_add SYS_ADMIN and the :rshared work-dir bind. All planned TDD tests exist (overlay happy path, base built-once/reused, base content+history-exclusion+dangling-symlink skip, isolation chowns only upper/work, fallback x3 cases, teardown x4, GC-safety location, isolation label, subprocess mounter, cli teardown, readiness parametrized). Scope discipline: gc.py and git_manager.py remain untouched. lifecycle.py was originally a declared non-goal but was deliberately modified later (commit f103db47c) to address review comment PRRT_kwDOSJAM6s6Gyua_, which required unmounting the Claude auth overlay in the PR-monitor's own filesystem GC path (run_workspace_filesystem_gc, which passes no compose_teardown hook) before rmtree of auth/<workspace_id>, mirroring the service-gc unmount-before-remove ordering and preventing an EBUSY mount leak; the change is additive (a best-effort _teardown_completed_workspace_auth_overlay helper plus one call site) and covered by tests/unit/runtime/test_monitor_completion_gc.py.
gaps: Scope expansion: src/awf/runtime/pr_monitor_runner/lifecycle.py was listed as an explicit non-goal (reserved for WS-B1/B2/B3) but was modified in commit f103db47c in response to review comment PRRT_kwDOSJAM6s6Gyua_ (unmount auth overlay in PR-monitor GC). The change is functionally correct, necessary to avoid an EBUSY overlay leak, and regression-tested, but it overlaps a file reserved for a parallel workstream — coordinate with WS-B before merge to avoid duplicate/conflicting teardown wiring in _gc_completed_workspace_filesystem.
